goal.sl: Poveš, kaj je kdo vprašal (He asked where I lived, She asked if I wanted tea), in vprašaš vljudno (Do you know where the inn is?).
goal.de: Du sagst, was jemand gefragt hat (He asked where I lived, She asked if I wanted tea), und fragst höflich (Do you know where the inn is?).
goal.it: Riferisci ciò che qualcuno ha chiesto (He asked where I lived, She asked if I wanted tea) e chiedi con cortesia (Do you know where the inn is?).
goal.en: You can report what someone asked (He asked where I lived, She asked if I wanted tea) and ask politely (Do you know where the inn is?).

say.sl: Vprašanje z vprašalnico: **asked** + **where**, **what**, **when** … + besedni red trdilne povedi, brez do in did. »Where do you live?« → **He asked where I lived.** (Vprašal je, kje živim.) »What do you want?« → **She asked what I wanted.** (Vprašala je, kaj želim.) Čas gre korak nazaj kot pri said.
say.de: Frage mit Fragewort: **asked** + **where**, **what**, **when** … + die Wortstellung des Aussagesatzes, ohne do und did. „Where do you live?“ → **He asked where I lived.** (Er fragte, wo ich wohne.) „What do you want?“ → **She asked what I wanted.** (Sie fragte, was ich wolle.) Die Zeit geht einen Schritt zurück wie bei said.
say.it: Domanda con parola interrogativa: **asked** + **where**, **what**, **when** … + l'ordine della frase affermativa, senza do e did. «Where do you live?» → **He asked where I lived.** (Ha chiesto dove abitavo.) «What do you want?» → **She asked what I wanted.** (Ha chiesto che cosa volevo.) Il tempo fa un passo indietro come con said.
say.en: A question with a question word: **asked** + **where**, **what**, **when** … + a statement's word order, with no do or did. "Where do you live?" → **He asked where I lived.** "What do you want?" → **She asked what I wanted.** The tense goes one step back, as with said.

say.sl: Da ali ne: **asked if** ali **asked whether** (ali). »Do you want tea?« → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Vprašala je, ali želim čaj.) »Can you help?« → **He asked whether I could help.** (Vprašal je, ali lahko pomagam.) Slovenski *ali* je tu **if**.
say.de: Ja oder nein: **asked if** oder **asked whether** (ob). „Do you want tea?“ → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Sie fragte, ob ich Tee wolle.) „Can you help?“ → **He asked whether I could help.** (Er fragte, ob ich helfen könne.) Deutsches *ob* ist hier **if**.
say.it: Sì o no: **asked if** o **asked whether** (se). «Do you want tea?» → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Ha chiesto se volevo del tè.) «Can you help?» → **He asked whether I could help.** (Ha chiesto se potevo aiutare.) Il *se* italiano qui è **if**.
say.en: Yes or no: **asked if** or **asked whether**. "Do you want tea?" → **She asked if I wanted tea.** "Can you help?" → **He asked whether I could help.**

say.sl: Pri be gre **was** za osebek: »Where is the inn?« → **She asked where the inn was.** (Vprašala je, kje je gostilna.) »Are you tired?« → **He asked if I was tired.** (Vprašal je, ali sem {m:utrujen|f:utrujena}.) Preteklik: »What did you see?« → **He asked what I had seen.** (Vprašal je, kaj sem {m:videl|f:videla}.) Če je še res, tudi **She asked where the inn is.**
say.de: Bei be kommt **was** nach dem Subjekt: „Where is the inn?“ → **She asked where the inn was.** (Sie fragte, wo das Gasthaus sei.) „Are you tired?“ → **He asked if I was tired.** (Er fragte, ob ich müde sei.) Die Vergangenheit: „What did you see?“ → **He asked what I had seen.** (Er fragte, was ich gesehen habe.) Wenn es noch stimmt, auch **She asked where the inn is.**
say.it: Con be, **was** va dopo il soggetto: «Where is the inn?» → **She asked where the inn was.** (Ha chiesto dov'era la locanda.) «Are you tired?» → **He asked if I was tired.** (Ha chiesto se ero stanc{m:o|f:a}.) Il passato: «What did you see?» → **He asked what I had seen.** (Ha chiesto che cosa avevo visto.) Se è ancora vero, anche **She asked where the inn is.**
say.en: With be, **was** goes after the subject: "Where is the inn?" → **She asked where the inn was.** "Are you tired?" → **He asked if I was tired.** The past: "What did you see?" → **He asked what I had seen.** If it's still so, also **She asked where the inn is.**

say.sl: V sedanjiku, enak besedni red, za vljudno vprašanje in za to, česar ne veš: **Do you know where the inn is?** (Ali veš, kje je gostilna?) **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** (Mi lahko poveš, kje ustavi avtobus?) **I don't know if Jack is coming.** (Ne vem, ali Jack pride.) **I wonder what she wants.** (Zanima me, kaj želi.)
say.de: Im Präsens, dieselbe Wortstellung, für eine höfliche Frage und für das, was du nicht weißt: **Do you know where the inn is?** (Weißt du, wo das Gasthaus ist?) **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** (Kannst du mir sagen, wo der Bus hält?) **I don't know if Jack is coming.** (Ich weiß nicht, ob Jack kommt.) **I wonder what she wants.** (Ich frage mich, was sie will.)
say.it: Al presente, stesso ordine, per una domanda cortese e per ciò che non sai: **Do you know where the inn is?** (Sai dov'è la locanda?) **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** (Puoi dirmi dove si ferma l'autobus?) **I don't know if Jack is coming.** (Non so se Jack viene.) **I wonder what she wants.** (Mi chiedo che cosa vuole.)
say.en: In the present, the same word order, for a polite question and for what you don't know: **Do you know where the inn is?** **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** **I don't know if Jack is coming.** **I wonder what she wants.**

say.sl: Pisno veljata **if** in besedni red trdilne povedi: **He asked if I wanted tea.** **He asked where I lived.** Ljudje rečejo tudi drugače: na Irskem, Škotskem in severu Anglije *He asked did I want tea* in *He asked where did I live*, in pogosto se sliši *Do you know where's the inn?* To boš slišal{m:|f:a}.
say.de: Geschrieben gelten **if** und die Wortstellung des Aussagesatzes: **He asked if I wanted tea.** **He asked where I lived.** Die Leute sagen es auch anders: in Irland, Schottland und Nordengland *He asked did I want tea* und *He asked where did I live*, und oft hört man *Do you know where's the inn?* Das wirst du hören.
say.it: Per iscritto valgono **if** e l'ordine della frase affermativa: **He asked if I wanted tea.** **He asked where I lived.** La gente lo dice anche in altri modi: in Irlanda, in Scozia e nel nord dell'Inghilterra *He asked did I want tea* e *He asked where did I live*, e spesso si sente *Do you know where's the inn?* Lo sentirai.
say.en: Writing wants **if** and a statement's word order: **He asked if I wanted tea.** **He asked where I lived.** People also say it otherwise: in Ireland, Scotland and the North *He asked did I want tea* and *He asked where did I live*, and you often hear *Do you know where's the inn?* You'll hear it.

say.sl: Ko je **who** ali **what** osebek, red ostane: »Who lives here?« → **She asked who lived there.** (Vprašala je, kdo tam živi.) Kdo je bil vprašan, stoji brez to: **She asked me where I lived.** (Vprašala me je, kje živim.) *She asked to me* je napaka. Odgovor poveš s **told**: **He told me where the inn was.** (Povedal mi je, kje je gostilna.)
say.de: Wenn **who** oder **what** das Subjekt ist, bleibt die Stellung: „Who lives here?“ → **She asked who lived there.** (Sie fragte, wer dort wohne.) Wer gefragt wurde, steht ohne to: **She asked me where I lived.** (Sie fragte mich, wo ich wohne.) *She asked to me* ist ein Fehler. Die Antwort gibst du mit **told**: **He told me where the inn was.** (Er sagte mir, wo das Gasthaus sei.)
say.it: Quando **who** o **what** è il soggetto, l'ordine resta: «Who lives here?» → **She asked who lived there.** (Ha chiesto chi abitava lì.) Chi viene interrogato sta senza to: **She asked me where I lived.** (Mi ha chiesto dove abitavo.) *She asked to me* è un errore. Per dare la risposta, **told**: **He told me where the inn was.** (Mi ha detto dov'era la locanda.)
say.en: When **who** or **what** is the subject, the order stays: "Who lives here?" → **She asked who lived there.** Who was asked stands with no to: **She asked me where I lived.** *She asked to me* is a mistake. To give the answer: **told**: **He told me where the inn was.**

translation.sl: Danes je v gostilno prišel neznanec. Vprašal je, od kod sem. Vprašal je, ali imamo sobo in koliko stane. {m:Vprašal|f:Vprašala} sem ga, kako dolgo želi ostati. Ni vedel. Vprašal me je, ali je do Keswicka daleč. Ali veš, kdo je?
translation.de: Heute kam ein Fremder ins Gasthaus. Er fragte, woher ich komme. Er fragte, ob wir ein Zimmer hätten und wie viel es koste. Ich fragte ihn, wie lange er bleiben wolle. Er wusste es nicht. Er fragte mich, ob es weit nach Keswick sei. Weißt du, wer er ist?
translation.it: Oggi è arrivato alla locanda uno sconosciuto. Ha chiesto da dove venivo. Ha chiesto se avevamo una camera e quanto costava. Gli ho chiesto quanto voleva restare. Non lo sapeva. Mi ha chiesto se era lontano Keswick. Sai chi è?
translation.en: A stranger came to the inn today. He asked where I came from. He asked if we had a room, and how much it cost. I asked him how long he wanted to stay. He didn't know. He asked me if it was far to Keswick. Do you know who he is?
